verdict.rationale: PayPal's own docs show customers can click a PayPal button and pay with any linked funding source, which hands checkout to PayPal rather than the merchant's UI. No-code Payment Links can be shared on a website. Conversion claims include Fastlane autofill and a reach of up to 400M users with Pay Later and card options. However, no evidence documents a developer-facing redirect to a full PayPal-hosted checkout page (session creation, return/cancel URLs), and the closest explicit 'secure PayPal payment page without building your own payment flow' is scoped to Invoicing. Missing for 10: documented hosted-checkout redirect flow for developers, evidence the hosted page is conversion-optimized beyond marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
